heading: INT. ANSWERING MACHINE - PARKED CAR OUTSIDE A HOSPITAL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ANSWERING MACHINE - PARKED CAR OUTSIDE A HOSPITAL - NIGHT
Dashboard glow.
A paper coffee cup.
Sodium lights smearing across the windshield.
The engine ticks as it cools.
CORNELIUS AJAYI-WHITLOCK, 60s, tie loosened, grips the steering wheel with both hands.
A phone rests in the cup holder, speaker on.
You have reached the home of the Ajayi-Whitlock family. We can't come to the phone right now. Leave a message.
units.name: MACHINE

units.text: BEEP.
Hey, Mara. It's Dad.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: He clears his throat.
I know you're not going to pick up. You haven't picked up in three years. That's fine. I'm not calling to make you.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: He rubs his eyes with the heel of his hand.
Your mother's room is on the fourth floor. Bed six. They moved her out of intensive care this afternoon. She asked about you. She asked if the flowers on her windowsill were from you. I told her yes.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: A long breath.
They weren't. I bought them. At the corner shop. But I thought, what's one more lie after thirty years of marriage. She smiled. That was enough.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: His voice cracks.
He lets it.
A nurse passes the windshield in the lot.
He doesn't look.
The doctor says it could be days. Could be weeks. Could be a month. They don't know. They never know.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: He grips the wheel harder.
I'm not asking you to come. I'm only telling you where we are. Fourth floor. Bed six. Visiting hours until nine. After that, tell the desk you're family. They'll let you in.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: He reaches for the phone.
Stops.
I did love the way you used to leave messages on this machine. Do you remember? You'd sing. Wrong notes. Every time.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: A pause.
Sing something, Mara. If you want. Anything.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: He waits.
Only static.
Then the long tone of the machine closing the line.
Your message has been saved.
units.name: MACHINE
